verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping API, so proxy options for hard-to-scrape sites are a fair question to ask of it. However, none of its docs mention residential, datacenter, or premium proxy options. The only proxy-related material is a community question and a complaint that proxies are never mentioned, which is not affirmative evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use premium residential or datacenter proxies to bypass sites that are hard to scrape
